products.title: Drop Shot Axion Attack 2024 Jon Sanz - Palas De Padel
products.description:
DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ - Jon Sanz's new padel racket for 2024 in the Premier Pádel professional padel league. A model that combines great precision, along with fantastic power thanks to its teardrop mold and technologies.

 INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

Drop Shot is one of the leading brands in the padel racket sector. Models like the classic Conqueror have been with us for almost a decade. Today we bring you the DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ, the new racket that the Premier Padel player Jon Sanz will use, and that seeks maximum power without losing the control that characterizes it.

PLAYER TYPE

The DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ has been created for advanced or professional level players looking for a versatile padel racket made of great materials.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The new DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ contains elements that make it stand out as a perfect padel racket for powerful players. It is a racket created in a teardrop format, with a good sweet spot and handling, which facilitates maximum power in the game without loss of control.

In its manufacturing, Drop Shot has used common elements in its padel rackets such as plain carbon and Hotmelt technology to make its frame more resistant and durable, a double tubular of carbon fabrics with maximum durability, which gives it greater rigidity and allows it to not lose power. Textrem Cubicarbon 18K twill technology appears on the interlocking carbon faces, giving the faces flexibility and greater durability for a more comfortable and pleasant touch.

Along with these materials, top-of-the-range technologies appear such as the 3D FACE, in a rhomboidal shape that provides greater spin to the ball when hitting, ideal for aggressive players and sliced ​​shots. The Anti Twist System technology also appears in this model, preventing vibrations, making this DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ one of the ideal padel rackets for players who want a powerful racket but with good balance.  In the core we find EVA PRO rubber with greater hardness and elasticity, which provides better control and touch of the ball.

It incorporates a protector on the frame of the racket to increase its durability, what the Madrid firm calls Ergo Pro Protector.

BLADE DESIGN

The design of the DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ has opted for a striking color combination, which changes yellow, silver, black and green.

PLAY STYLE

The new DROP SHOT EXPLORER PRO 3.0 is one of the ideal Drop Shot rackets for advanced or professional players who want an attacking racket, but with good control.

products.title: Drop Shot Axion Attack 2.0 2026 - Drop Shot
products.description:
DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2.0 2026 - Jon Sanz's new padel racket for the 2026 season. An offensive racket, in teardrop format. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2.0 2026 is the official padel racket of Jon Sanz, developed together with the Navarrese player for the 2026 season. This padel racket offers everything that a professional padel racket can offer, which is a comfortable feel, versatile game and a Premium design.

PLAYER TYPE

This model is focused on high-level, competitive players looking to have a professional player's racket. Recommended above all to an offensive player rather than a defensive one.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The new DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2.0 2026 offers high power but with good control thanks to its teardrop format and medium-high balance, with the right and necessary sweet spot. Maintains a good level of control in long exchanges.

The Eva Pro High Density core provides a firm and stable feel, ideal for players looking for a solid response on impact and greater security in each shot.

The faces are made of 24K Twill Carbon, a light and reactive material that improves the ball's exit speed and provides a more defined feel when hitting.

Other technologies of this racket is the Ergo Pro Protector system, a protector already incorporated to protect the frame from the typical friction of this sport. In addition, we highlight the anti-vibration system incorporated into the bridge called the Anti Twist System.
